integrity: Explicit analytic all-parameter proof, plus exactly enumerated finite consistency checks; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Counts retain labelled parallel-edge multiplicity; no extension to simple-graph conditioning, nonuniform attachment, longer cycles or variable-m multivariate Poisson approximation. Priority is based on accessible sources, not an independent literature certification.
title: Exact negative covariance of two- and three-cycle counts in uniform attachment multigraphs
